en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic domed church on a city square. The building has a massive central dome with lantern, a tall bell tower on the left, a neoclassical façade with columns and pediment, and a semicircular colonnaded back section topped with numerous statues. Trees line the curved street and sidewalks in the foreground; surrounding urban buildings are partly visible. The image edges are irregularly cut, suggesting an old print or postcard. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
